visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with her hair tied in a neat bun, wearing a black zip-up hoodie and dark blue wide-leg jeans, stands in a brightly lit retail store at a cosmetics counter. She reaches out to touch a display shelf filled with ELIXIR products. (2) Close-up shots reveal various ELIXIR skincare products including bottles of lotion, tubes of masks, and jars of cream, all neatly arranged on white shelves with clear price tags. (3) The woman holds a small light blue jar of 'BALANCING MIZU CREAM,' unscrews the white lid, and uses her finger to take a dab of the translucent gel-like cream, applying it to her cheek with a smile. (4) She presents two bottles of 'BALANCING OSHIROI MILK' sunscreen, squeezing a small amount onto the back of her hand to show the texture, then applies it to her face. (5) She holds a tube of 'BALANCING OYASUMI MASK,' squeezing a clear gel onto her fingertips and massaging it into her skin, demonstrating its smooth application. (6) The woman uses a white bottle of 'BALANCING BUBBLE' cleanser; she pumps the gel into her palm and it instantly transforms into thick, white foam which she then applies to her entire face. (7) She pours a clear liquid toner onto a white cotton pad and gently wipes her face. (8) She applies a white milky lotion from a bottle to her hand and massages it into her face using upward strokes. (9) Wide shots show multiple ELIXIR brand counters located inside various Japanese drugstores and shopping centers like Sundrug and Matsumoto Kiyoshi.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 推薦給小資女們最容易入手的專櫃品牌 全部都約台幣500 /. [Logo]: 日本失心瘋. (2) [Subtitle]: 《留言抽兩支正貨》. (3) [Subtitle]: 潔顏慕斯、化妝水、乳液 水凝霜、晚安凍膜、蜜粉乳 基礎保養商品全都有. (4) [Subtitle]: 來分享 3款 我最推薦入手的品項. (5) [Subtitle]: 平衡保濕水凝霜. [Variety]: みずクリーム. (6) [Subtitle]: 這款我單獨介紹過 是針對水油平衡調理的水凝霜. (7) [Subtitle]: 質地是水霧狀的，很特別 擦起來清爽薄透，很適合夏天. (8) [Subtitle]: 在臉上推開很快就 化成水狀被肌膚吸收囉. (9) [Subtitle]: 水油平衡防曬隔離乳. [Variety]: おしろいミルク. (10) [Subtitle]: 外表擦的跟防曬顏色 有白色和膚色兩款顏色. (11) [Subtitle]: 推開的延展性非常好 保濕度也很高. (12) [Subtitle]: 防曬係數是最高等級 SPF50/PA++++ 平日外出非常夠用. (13) [Subtitle]: 水油平衡晚安面膜. [Variety]: おやすみマスク. (14) [Subtitle]: 夏天睡冷氣房 我都會擦薄薄的晚安面膜 避免肌膚水分被空調帶走. (15) [Subtitle]: 這款塗起來很滑順 隔天起床皮膚很水嫩唷. (16) [Subtitle]: 我用一陣子了，很喜歡 一支不用台幣400，真的很划算. (17) [Subtitle]: 加碼分享 質地神奇的潔顏慕斯. (18) [Subtitle]: 擠出來的時候 是凝膠狀的. (19) [Subtitle]: 碰到體溫會瞬間變成慕斯狀 轉化成軟綿綿的泡泡. (20) [Subtitle]: 實際洗起來的感覺也很棒 乾淨又好沖洗，洗完也不緊繃 還可以直接卸掉淡妝. (21) [Subtitle]: 同系列化妝水也不錯 簡單上完也提升透明感. (22) [Subtitle]: 我混合肌，我用清爽型 化妝水和乳液有分兩款 清爽型 & 滋潤型 乾肌的朋友建議用滋潤型喔. (23) [Subtitle]: 乳液上起來也很舒服 推薦一般日常保養使用. (24) [Subtitle]: ELIXIR怡麗絲爾 在日本很多地方都有櫃位. (25) [Subtitle]: 像松本清、SUNDRUG等藥妝店 或是唐吉軻德也都有賣. (26) [Subtitle]: 今年夏天 換這系列試試吧.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A bright synthesizer bell 'ding' introduces an upbeat, high-tempo electronic pop BGM with a consistent 128 BPM beat. A female voice speaks in Mandarin with high energy and a friendly tone, immediately setting a positive mood. (2) As the narrator introduces the brand, the music maintains its cheerful rhythm. The speech rate is fast but clear. A subtle 'click' sound effect coincides with the first visual transition to the products. (3) Upon introducing the 'Balancing Mizu Cream,' a soft 'pop' SFX is heard. The narrator's pitch remains high and engaging, articulating each product benefit clearly over the background music. (4) The music continues at a steady volume as the narrator details the sunscreen's SPF properties. Her tone is professional and persuasive, with minimal pauses between sentences. (5) A bubbly, squelching sound effect is used as the narrator demonstrates the cleanser turning into foam. Her voice reflects excitement and wonder, matching the visual spectacle of the product transformation. (6) The video concludes with the narrator encouraging viewers to try the series. The BGM maintains its upbeat tempo until a final hard cut ends the audio track abruptly along with the speech.
